summary: Frontend-only verification of AP Pickleball Club changes. Tested 9 request items across desktop (1920) and mobile (390) viewports on /, /contact, /bollywood-vibes, /tcd-cafe. Vast majority of requested changes verified as working. One minor inconsistency: the top scrolling marquee still contains the text '4.9★ on Google' (2 occurrences) even though the Reviews card correctly shows 4.5 with a half star.

ui_bugs.issue: Contains stale text '4.9★ on Google' (appears twice in marquee). Reviews card was correctly updated to 4.5 with half star, but marquee copy was not updated. Creates inconsistency.

action_items: Update the top marquee copy to say '4.5★ on Google' (or remove the rating token from marquee) so it matches the Reviews card. Likely in a component that renders react-fast-marquee content.
critical_code_review_comments: Rating is duplicated as string literals in multiple places (Reviews card + marquee). Consider extracting to a single constant (e.g., GOOGLE_RATING) to avoid future drift.
Global FloatingWhatsApp mounted in App.js inside BrowserRouter — verified single instance per route (no duplicates on subpages).

Verified all requested data-testid selectors present: floating-whatsapp-btn, hero-paddle, hero-paddle-mobile, hero-slider, hero-slide-dot-0/1/2, nav-contact-btn, nav-book-cta, mobile-menu-button, mobile-menu-panel, insta-profile-card-thaltej, insta-profile-card-gandhinagar, booking-link-website, booking-link-whatsapp, booking-appstore-badge, booking-playstore-badge.
